title: Medial danger zone
view: Adult male supine from directly above, patient's right on the image left, the rib cage drawn over the chest; inset: one intercostal space in sagittal section, skin on the left, pleura on the right, head up.
teachingPoint: The internal mammary artery runs 1-2 cm lateral to the sternum: stay out at the midclavicular line. Go over the top of the rib below; the bundle runs under the rib above.
claims: Red bands: 0-2 cm lateral to each sternal edge, with the internal mammary arteries drawn about 1.2 cm out (record: 1-2 cm lateral to the sternum); drawn projected, they run deep to the cartilages.
Teal on the dashed right MCL: the 2nd intercostal space site, clear of the band (record: stay in the midclavicular line).

Inset (not to scale): vein, artery and nerve in the costal groove under the upper rib; the catheter passes perpendicular just over the lower rib (record: bundle along the inferior rib margin; steps: over the rib, perpendicular).
Torso photograph shared with needle_decompression_landmarks; rib cage drawn over it (owner, 2026-10-02).
Labels: Internal mammary artery, Midclavicular line, 2nd ICS, MCL, Neurovascular bundle, Rib below.
